solid.$description: Carbon's $link-primary / $interactive / $button-primary all share Blue 60 (#0f62fe) — the one color that unambiguously anchors the brand across every Carbon core token group.

Carbon's own $button-secondary (Gray 80, #393939) — a real, named secondary role, unlike GOV.UK. Light mode only: the G100 theme's own $button-secondary value wasn't independently confirmed against the live source for this adoption, so dark mode falls back to this same value rather than guessing (see the findings ledger).
Carbon's core tokens don't name a 'neutral brand' role either; Gray 60 (#6f6f6f, Carbon's $text-helper/$icon-secondary gray) is the closest authored anchor.

ring.$description: Carbon's own $focus token — another clean 1:1 mapping, and mode-aware out of the box (blue on White, white on G100).

md.$description: Carbon's core structural components (buttons, inputs, tiles) render square by default — a handful of components (tags, tooltips) use a small radius, but there's no single catalog-level radius.md that captures both, so this binds the dominant structural value.
